change: record_finding and update_finding read a method without status as a confirmation attempt, with the same checks as status=confirmed. When the checks fail, the finding and the other fields are saved and the reply says why it is still a candidate. A candidate the validator disproved is confirmed again only with status=confirmed. Benchmark scores count an expected item matched only by a candidate finding as left as a candidate.
reason: record_finding with a method and no status saved a candidate without a word, and the planner then worked as if the finding were confirmed: visible in every targeted trace. Replaying the finding calls of the three collapsed runs against the new tools turns 144 refusals into 4, and in the p003 candidate runs a method-only call confirmed a finding. It ran together with P-003 (dropped), so it has no judge numbers of its own, and it does not stop the planner repeating a call that can't succeed.
